title: Reply: energy conservation is not universal in physics

statements.text: Collins argues that appeals to conservation are a red herring, because conservation principles are not ubiquitous in physics: energy is not conserved in general relativity, in quantum theory, or in the universe as a whole, so there is no reason to insist on it for mind and brain.

sources.quote: He argues that energy is not conserved in general relativity, in quantum theory, or in the universe taken as a whole.
